facility.name: Trina Hawkins
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation: One household member not counted in ratio did not have documentation verifying orientation to the child-care home was completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation (26 TAC §747.905(2))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months: The primary caregiver did not have documentation of one hour training in the following topic to complete last year's annual training:  (1)Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome; (2)Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infantdeath syndrome (SIDS) and (3)Understanding early childhood brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months (26 TAC §747.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: The operation did not have documentation of current vaccines for the dog at the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment: One child's record did not have signed documentation by the parent that the parent was informed the operation does not carry liability insurance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §747.213(a))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: The stationary equipment on the playground is not meeting use zones of  six feet in all directions from the perimeter of the equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §747.4603)

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The primary caregiver did not have documentation of training in the following topics to complete last year's annual training: 1) Emergency Preparedness; 2) preventing and controlling the spread of communicable disease including immunizations; 3) understanding building and physical premises safety; 4) handling, storing, hazardous materials; 5) food allergies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The children records evaluated did not have documentation showing the parents have been informed of the parents rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete. One child's record lacked a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Wood was observed on the playground that has jagged edges  that can cause splinters and needs to be sanded down. A hammer was observed on the railing of the fence on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: This standard was reviewed on 10/6/2023 as a follow-up to a previous inspection and found deficient. The operation did not have safety documentation for smoke detectors checks on file for review by Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Electrical outlets in the home in different rooms used by the children were observed without child proof covers as well as one on the playground. A bucket of different containers of chemicals was observed in the walk way from the home to the playground that is accessible to children. Coins were observed on a side table in the living room as well as a near empty can of chewing tobacco. The coins and chewing tobacco were removed from the table during inspection and put out of the reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The primary caregiver did not have documentation on file for review showing she has current first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Enrollment Agreement: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's record lacked their date of admission. Two children's record lacked the address of their designated contact. One child's doctor information was missing an address. One child's immunization record was observed in complete. One child's record lacked a health statement. One child's record lacked documentation that the parent received a copy of the operational policies/parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The operation did not have safety documentation for  emergency drills, fire extinguishers, smoke detectors on file for review by Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System: The batteries in one of the smoke detectors did not work. Staff replaced the batteries during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)

occurrences.finding: Ammunition Kept Separate, Locked and Inaccessible to Children: The ammunition is not being kept in a separate locked cabinet from the fire arms/guns.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Ammunition Kept Separate, Locked and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3505(b))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: This standard was reviewed on 9/28/2022 as a follow-up to a previous inspection and found deficient. The fence on one side of the playground is not 4 feet tall. The two gates to the fence do not have latches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §747.4105)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There was metal with sharp edges on the playground and picnic table with broken plastic on the table that poses as a pinching hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: This standard was reviewed on 10/12/2022 as a follow-up to a previous inspection and found deficient. The home did not have a statement of health from the local veterinarian on file for review for two dogs at the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: This standard was reviewed on 9/28/2022 as a follow-up to a previous inspection and found deficient. The home did not have a statement of health from the local veterinarian on file for review for two dogs at the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: This standard was reviewed on 9/28/2022 as a follow-up to a previous inspection and found deficient. The fence is missing from one side of the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §747.4105)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two children's records lacked a health statement and an immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment: The operation does not have documentation on file for review by Child Care Regulation that parents have been notified that the operation does not carry liability insurance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §747.213(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow: The operation does not have a written activity plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The operation does not have child safety latches for the drawers and cabinet on the bathroom sink. The small trash can in the restroom does not have a lid. The closet in the home with the a/c unit does not have a child proof knob or lock to preven the children's access.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Electric or Battery Operated CO Detection System- Installed in Compliance with State or Local Fire Marshal's Instructions: The home did not have a carbon monoxide detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO Detection System- Installed in Compliance with State or Local Fire Marshal's Instructions (26 TAC §747.5335(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The home did not have operational policies for review by Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Pet Vaccinations: Pet vaccination records were not available for the three dogs at the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Pet Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training: A personnel record was not available for review for the household member.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training (26 TAC §747.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: Children records were not available for review by Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal: The home did not have a 3A-40BC dry chemical fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §747.5103)

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: The home does not have a fenced outdoor activity space for the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §747.4105)

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The home did not have documentation certifying that the CPSC recall list has been reviewed and that there are not recalled items in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The household member does not have a background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The operation did not have a emergency preparedness plan available for review by Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster: The home did not have any postings for review by Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Keeping Children Safe Poster (26 TAC §747.401(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Complete Kit: The first aid kit lacked adhesive tape and a first aid guide.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Complete Kit (26 TAC §747.3803(a))

occurrences.finding: Ammunition Kept Separate, Locked and Inaccessible to Children: The ammunition for the fire arms in the home is not kept in a separate locked container or cabinet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Ammunition Kept Separate, Locked and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3505(b))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: The home did not have a statement of health from the local veterinarian on file for review for three dogs at the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))
